detail: No FinCon code, prompts, environment, configs, or tests are released.
No exact multimodal dataset, file manifest, hashes, schemas, or timestamps are released.
Refinitiv, Zacks, Capital IQ, Alpaca, and ECC inputs are not archived with the paper.
Raw-data prose names Yahoo/Alpaca/Capital IQ while the adjacent table names Refinitiv/Zacks/SEC/Yahoo/ECC.
Experimental setup ends 2023-06-10; raw-data section says 2022-06-10.
GPT-4-Turbo API model/version/date is not pinned.
Whisper API model/version and transcription settings are not pinned.
System, role, analysis, action, reflection, CVRF, and baseline-adaptation prompts are absent.
Seed, top-p, max tokens, retries, timeout, and response parsing are absent.
Seven analyst types are claimed but their exact instantiated roster and per-task activation are not fully enumerated.
Agent-specific initial importance and decay ratios are omitted.
Embedding model, normalization, and retrieval tie handling are omitted.
Database schema, event construction, pruning, and episode reset semantics are omitted.
Window, minimum observations, quantile interpolation, and exact trigger comparison are omitted.
Concept extraction, comparison, update prompt, and update parsing are omitted.
Mapping from action overlap to prompt edits is not operationally specified.
Decision time, execution price, next-day mapping, position persistence, cash, leverage, and short constraints are omitted.
Solver, objective coefficients, constraints, covariance estimator, and direction-to-bound mapping are not fully specified.
Transaction costs, slippage, borrowing costs, and liquidity constraints are omitted.
Sharpe risk-free rate, periodicity, and annualization are omitted.
Exact CR, SR, and MDD code and aggregation conventions are absent.
Seeds and whether baseline repetitions share data/model randomness are omitted.
Appendix says the reported setting maximizes test cumulative return; the candidate settings and selection procedure are absent.
Wilcoxon pairing samples, comparator, statistic, p-values, corrections, and effect sizes are absent.
Observation features, preprocessing, action space, reward, hyperparameters, seeds, and checkpoints are absent.
Exact commits and dependencies for GA, FinGPT, FinMem, FinAgent, FinRL, and FinRL-Meta are not pinned.
Finance prompt modifications and multimodal alignment are not released.
The exact 42-symbol eligible universe and point-in-time filtering record are not released as data.
Deterministic selection inputs and outputs for P1/P2 are not released.
Actions, prompts, responses, memory states, prices, PnL, and per-run metrics are absent.
All 106 published result series are raster-only; no plotting inputs or scripts are released.
The paper does not explain why 64 shared numeric cells changed between v2 and v3.
VIX computation/source, threshold selection procedure, and separate model/config details are not pinned.
